Priya R.: Hey team — acme POC is hitting 429s after ~200 reqs in a short burst. They reported intermittent "quota_exceeded" with route "/v1/chat/generate". Any quick ideas?
Alice S.: can you paste a sample request id + the x-token-count header? also what model/route?
Priya R.: model: gpt-4x-infer-8k, route: /v1/chat/generate, sample x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d, x-token-count: 14500, timestamp: 2026-02-14T16:20Z
Ben I.: that token count is per-request tokens, but the 429 looks like per-route burst window. We're seeing a default burst bucket = 100 reqs / 1m for new trials.
SamBot: alert: quota_spike detected for tenant acme-corp (peak: 220 req/min) — flagged for manual review.
Alice S.: two quick checks: 1) confirm per-route caps in the tenant UI (Console -> Tenants -> acme-corp -> Quotas). 2) run `infra quota-inspect --tenant acme-corp --route /v1/chat/generate` and paste output.
Priya R.: ran quota-inspect output: "route_limit: 100rm/min, burst_bucket: 150, token_budget: 1e6/month, used_bucket: 150"
Ben I.: looks like they exhausted burst_bucket. The service enforces a sliding refill; once used_bucket==burst_bucket you'll get 429s until it refills. For POC we can: a) apply a temporary per-route override bump to 400rm/min, or b) enable short-term token borrowing from account bucket.
Alice S.: to do the temporary bump DM me and @ben and I can apply a non-prod override. Note: overrides for trials are gated (no billing commit required) but will be auto-revoked in 24h unless sales ops approves.
Priya R.: can we do the override now? customer demo in 30m.
Ben I.: applying override now... patching quota: `PATCH /internal/tenants/acme-corp/quotas {"/v1/chat/generate": {"rate": 400, "burst": 1000}}`
SamBot: change-applied: quota override applied by Ben I. (id: qov_9f7g)
Priya R.: getting green again, requests flowing, no 429s in the last 2m. Thanks!
Alice S.: follow-up: we'll add a short note in the POC runbook: recommended per-route bump for heavy generation demos + monitor with `metrics.query("tenant.acme.*.429_count")`.
Julia: FYI finance: this override is non-billable for trials — flagged to sales_ops for formal approval if they want extended capacity.
Priya R.: great, I'll update the customer and schedule post-demo follow-up on pricing/commits. :thumbsup:
